checkpoints.name: ssi_exponential_lower_bound
checkpoints.description: Theorem 1 of van Dijk-Loho-Maat (CSL 2024, arXiv 2309.02223v1), parity-game content: for the explicit sink-parity-game family G_n (2n+2 nodes, 6n edges) and any improvement rule, no legal SSI chain from the initial pair (sigma0, tau0) of length at most 2^{n+1}-3 ends at the optimal strategy pair; iterations are modeled by a non-deterministic step relation with existentially quantified optimal counterstrategies (see tests/reference/concept-ledger.md).
